entries.title: Track every product unit
entries.description: Browse machines by serial number, product, owner, or build state, then view each unit’s VIN, fitted assemblies, ownership history, and related jobs.

entries.title: Start stock builds directly
entries.description: Create showroom stock builds without a customer quote, including the build specification, serial number, and bay schedule.

entries.title: Allocate stock to customer quotes
entries.description: Select an existing stock unit when creating a quote, see competing quotes, and transfer ownership automatically when the sale is accepted.

entries.title: Record ownership changes
entries.description: Record transfers between customers and stock, including the effective date and an optional note, without affecting sales figures.

entries.title: Start rework jobs
entries.description: Start a rework job when an allocated machine needs changes, keeping the work and build specification tied to the same unit.

entries.title: Ask the assistant about product units
entries.description: The assistant can now find machines, report their current owner and history, and link directly to their unit pages.

entries.title: Browse catalog filters more easily
entries.description: Range and variant filters now stay compact on smaller screens, with extra choices collected into a More menu.

entries.title: Reach the correct website automatically
entries.description: Links using the www address now redirect cleanly to the main site while preserving the requested page and filters.

entries.title: Contact the WhatsApp team directly
entries.description: The contact page now opens the dedicated Jedidiah WhatsApp number.

entries.title: Review allocated units on quotes
entries.description: Product quotes now show the allocated machine’s serial number and VIN, while clearly indicating that allocation is managed on the web app.

entries.title: Update invoice numbers after acceptance
entries.description: Invoice numbers can now be added or changed on locked quotes from the mobile app.
